fellow_id.description: Fellow name or product name being synthesized.

synthesis_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when this synthesis was produced.

design_partners_synthesized.description: Number of distinct design partner feedback artifacts ingested for this synthesis.

themes.description: Top 3 themes across the feedback, ranked by impact on Gate G4 readiness.

partners_raising.description: Identifiers of the partners who raised this theme.

severity.description: How severely this theme threatens Gate G4 readiness.

critical_objections.description: Specific objections that, if unaddressed, would block paying customers. May be empty.

blocks_paying.description: True if this objection, unresolved, would prevent the partner from paying.

must_fix_for_g4.description: 1-sentence items the Fellow must ship or fix before Gate G4 is realistic.

nice_to_have_post_launch.description: Lower-priority requests worth tracking but not blocking G4. May be empty.

next_sprint_brief.description: One paragraph (3-5 sentences), Fellow-facing, written to be read first thing Monday morning. Specific, not generic.

kill_signal_flags.description: Utopia Kill Signals triggered by evidence in the feedback. Only flag with clear textual basis. May be empty.

signal.description: Which of the four Kill Signals this flag corresponds to.

triggered_by.description: Exact quote or close paraphrase from the input that triggered this flag.

rationale.description: One sentence explaining why this evidence triggers this signal.

g4_readiness_score.description: Studio operator's view of how close this Fellow is to Gate G4 readiness, on a 1-10 scale.

g4_readiness_rationale.description: 1-2 sentence justification for the readiness score.

scorecard_present.description: True if a SCORECARD ARTIFACT block was provided as input, false otherwise.

scorecard_gaps_flagged.description: Metrics that should be tracked for this venture's G4 readiness assessment but are absent from the scorecard (or absent because no scorecard was provided). Each string is a one-line description of the missing metric. May be empty.
